headline: RBI panel starts meet on interest rate; announcement Friday - OrissaPOST
summary: The RBI's six-member Monetary Policy Committee, headed by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, began deliberations on interest rates on Wednesday. The decision will be announced Friday morning.
why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the country's benchmark policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, the rupee and local equity valuations.
